channel.title: GitHub Trending, Minus the AI
channel.description: A non-AI view of GitHub Trending — a daily digest of open-source tools, libraries, languages, and projects trending right now.

item.title: GitHub Trending, Minus the AI — November 17, 2026
item.description:
Today's 52 trending open-source repositories, with AI-focused projects filtered out. Highlights:

  1. codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x (563,331 ⭐) — Master programming by recreating your favorite technologies from scratch.
  2. public-apis/public-apis (499,757 ⭐) — A collective list of free APIs
  3. freeCodeCamp/freeCodeCamp (459,245 ⭐) — freeCodeCamp.org's open-source codebase and curriculum. Learn math, programming, and computer science for free.
  4. EbookFoundation/free-programming-books (401,752 ⭐) — :books: Freely available programming books
  5. nilbuild/developer-roadmap (372,214 ⭐) — Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
  6. awesome-selfhosted/awesome-selfhosted (337,925 ⭐) — A list of Free Software network services and web applications which can be hosted on your own servers
  7. vinta/awesome-python (335,386 ⭐) — The definitive list that answers "I want to do X in Python, which tool should I use?"
  8. practical-tutorials/project-based-learning (289,909 ⭐) — Curated list of project-based tutorials
  9. torvalds/linux (256,129 ⭐) — Linux kernel source tree
  10. react/react (252,817 ⭐) — The library for web and native user interfaces.
